searchText: Hi <@199561711278227457>, I am testing and debugging the consensus layer Caplin with Erigon, and I’d like to request some validators on devnet-6 to see how it works. Yeah we don't have fine grained "send api call" to subset of hosts type functionality afaik. So it would be easier if you ran a node locally or if i gave you the credentials to talk to a node's rpc directly instead of via the lb hey! can i just give you some testnet eth and you make deposits with it? they shouldn't take long to activate Sure. Maybe I can pm you my test wallet? I can spin my own node too. Just not sure how I do that, I guess I need to pass this to geth <https://config.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/el/genesis.json>? and I guess I need to find some seed nodes do you happen to have the command for geth on hand? :) this script should have everything: https://pastebin.com/6nxFPmht We would like to keep devnet-5 online for testing since <https://pectra-devnet-6.beaconcha.in/> is offline and it will stays offline for at least another week. Is that possible <@199561711278227457> <@808969530608451584> ? Our issue is we depend on beaconcha.in APIs for the launchpad and since those aren't available for devnet-6 yet, we are getting somewhat screwed if devnet-5 dies now. <https://rpc.pectra-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/> seems to be failing for many of us with MetaMask. yeah ofc, i can leave it up! checking it should be working again! Thanks Our issue is we depend on beaconcha.in
